verdict.rationale: Obsidian ships Graph view as a core plugin that visualizes the relationships between notes in a vault [obsidian-docs-3]. Those relationships come from internal links, which the docs describe as building a network of knowledge [obsidian-docs-18]. That covers the core of exploring a knowledge base as a graph, but the evidence only states that it visualizes. missing for 10: documentation of filtering the graph (by tag, folder, search, or local graph), evidence of interactivity such as navigating or clicking nodes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
